tweets.text:
The same Congressman refers to Tom Homan as the architect of family separation.  Zero tolerance was used in an effort to save lives and stop the sexual assault of children and women making that journey.  Prosecuting those who violate our laws actually decreased both. American families get separated by law enforcement across this nation hundreds of times every day because a parent is prosecuted and the child cannot go to jail with the prosecuted parent.  But they want illegal aliens not held to the same standards. I noticed he did not mention the more than 500,000 family separations that occurred under Biden. A half million children were separated and put in the hands of a criminal cartel to be smuggled and trafficked into the US and released to sponsors who were not properly vetted and that is according to whistleblowers who worked at HHS that handled those cases. According to whistleblowers they could not connect and  could not follow up on nearly 300,000.  Many of these children are safe, but many are now victims of forced labor and sex trafficking.  ICE has already found some in forced labor. The last administration didn’t find them and save them, but we will. What the Biden Administration did was far worse than anything that any previous administration has ever done. And Mr Congressman, YOU DID
NOTHING TO STOP IT. Like most of your party, you remained silent and allowed it. Shame.

tweets.text:
At yesterday’s hearing, on sanctuary cities, several questioned and attacked a statement I made at CPAC in which I said “I am going to Boston and I am bringing hell with me”. I made that statement right after I spoke about nine child rapists that ICE took off the streets of Massachusetts. So yes, we are bringing it to every illegal alien that is a public safety threat, especially those who attack our most innocent and that message was and is directed to them. Let me be clear, I said it, I meant it, and not just Boston. Everyone in that hearing room should be shoulder to shoulder with me on this issue.  There is no sanctuary for child rapists. Our country becomes safer every day under President Trump’s leadership and his incredible support of ICE and Border Patrol. 
~Thomas D. Homan
